skirmish.module.base_os.name: Base OS
skirmish.module.base_os.description: Your base as an app (key B). The base is the region whose block has a hologram with your nick (or set it by hand). Every chest, barrel and shulker you open there goes into the storage: search all items including shulker contents, totals with auction prices and a route to the chest. Warns when stock drops below a minimum, when a stranger you can see enters the region, when a farm is ripe and when a countdown on the region hologram runs out. Base log and a 3D model of the region.
skirmish.module.base_os.setting.intruder: Warn about a stranger in the region you can see directly. Never invisible players, never through walls

skirmish.module.base_os.setting.open_key: Key for the Base OS screen
